cards.title: count() counts
cards.body: `text.count(x)` tells you how many times x appears in the text.

hi.title: count() ginta hai
hi.body: `text.count(x)` batata hai ki text mein x kitni baar aata hai.

cards.title: Capitals are different letters
cards.body: Python treats `A` and `a` as two different characters.

hi.title: Capitals alag letters hain
hi.body: Python `A` aur `a` ko do alag characters maanta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should count every `a`, big or small, and print 5, but it prints 2. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: Capitals are different letters, so `count("A")` misses the small ones. Count in a lowercase copy: `text.lower().count("a")`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse har `a` ginna chahiye, chhota ho ya bada, aur 5 print karna chahiye, par yeh 2 print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Capitals alag letters hain, isliye `count("A")` chhote waale chhod deta hai. Lowercase copy mein gino: `text.lower().count("a")`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: There is one o in hello and one in world.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: hello mein ek o hai aur world mein ek.

exercise.promptHi: Pehli line ek word hai, doosri ek akela letter. Print karo ki woh letter word mein kitni baar aata hai (capitals alag letters gine jaate hain).
